commands.name: serverinfo
commands.helpText: Shows the server name, online player count, and optional server info message.

commands.name: online
commands.helpText: Shows how many players are online and lists up to 10 names.

commands.name: discord
commands.helpText: Shows the configured Discord link for this server.

commands.name: rules
commands.helpText: Shows the configured server rules as a numbered list.

commands.name: kick
commands.helpText: Usage: kick <player> [reason] — kicks a player from the server.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.helpText: Optional reason shown to the target and in broadcasts

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Ban a player temporarily or permanently

arguments.name: duration
arguments.helpText: perm/permanent or a value like 10m, 12h, 7d, or 2w

arguments.name: reason
arguments.helpText: Optional reason shown in the ban confirmation and broadcasts

commands.name: givecurrency
commands.helpText: Usage: givecurrency <player> <amount> — amount must be a positive whole number.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.helpText: Amount of currency to give (positive whole number)

functions.name: server-toolkit-helpers
server-toolkit-pure

permissions.description: Allows a player to kick other players
Allows a player to ban other players
Allows a player to grant currency to players
